title: Pomerado
description_en: Turn any website into an API; Faster & reliable browser use. Pomerado turns any website into a MCP / API in minutes. Automate everything by turning previously inaccessible websites (like Google Flights, Zillow, Instacart, legacy portals) into native tools for your agents. Our open-source tool builds, hosts, authenticates, and maintains your integrations, so you can focus on building.
description_zh: Pomerado是一个开源的浏览器自动化工具，核心能力是将传统难以爬取的网站（如Google Flights、Zillow、Instacart、企业遗留系统）转换为标准化的MCP（Model Context Protocol）或API接口，供AI Agent直接调用。产品解决的核心痛点是：大量有价值的数据和功能被锁在动态网站、需要登录验证或反爬机制的平台中，传统爬虫难以稳定获取，而Pomerado通过浏览器级别的自动化+托管服务，让开发者无需维护复杂的爬虫逻辑，就能将这些网站变成Agent的原生工具。产品提供构建、托管、认证和维护的全流程服务，开发者只需专注业务逻辑。目前在Product Hunt获得171票，属于中等热度，GitHub开源但star数未知。

title: Dottr
description_en: Agent that drafts contracts, flags risks + gets them signed. Dottr is an AI teammate for contracts that lives in your email. Forward a thread or notes and it drafts the agreement from your templates, reviews risks in plain English, sends it for signature, and chases every signer until it’s done. Signers need no login. It also remembers the terms and dates so you can ask what you agreed later. From draft to signed instantly, so the yes doesn’t go cold.
description_zh: Dottr是一个嵌入邮件的AI合同代理，解决中小企业合同流程繁琐、签署周期长的问题。用户只需转发邮件线程或笔记，AI即可从模板库自动起草合同、用白话标注法律风险、发送签署请求并持续追踪所有签署方直到完成。核心创新在于：①签署方无需注册登录（降低摩擦）②AI记忆所有条款和日期，可随时查询历史协议③全流程在邮件内完成，符合商务人员习惯。目标用户是需要快速签约但无专职法务的中小企业销售、运营团队。Product Hunt获120票显示有一定市场验证，但缺乏更详细的用户数据和增长指标。

title: Ultracite v8
description_en: The linter and formatter for agentic development. Agents write most of the code now. Ultracite is the linter and formatter for agentic development, a zero-config preset for Oxlint, Biome, and ESLint that keeps agent-written code consistent and type-safe. Ultracite checks every edit agents make against hundreds of strict rules in under half a second, so what reaches review is consistent, type-safe code instead of slop. Used by engineering teams at OpenAI, Vercel, Mintlify, and thousands of open source projects: ultracite.ai

title: Skisso
description_en: Edit your live UI in your design system, hand off the diff. Skisso is a free Chrome extension for designers and developers who build with AI coding agents. Point at any element on your live product and edit it in your own design system: your tokens, your components, a shadcn/ui kit that matches your styles. Then hand your agent only the exact change, as a small diff or over MCP. No more describing pixels in prose or pasting the whole page: about 380 tokens instead of 25,700 in our test. Runs locally, no account.
description_zh: Skisso解决AI coding agent时代的设计-开发协作痛点：传统方式需要用自然语言描述UI改动或粘贴整页代码，导致token消耗巨大且容易出错。产品是免费Chrome插件，让设计师直接在live产品上点选任意元素，在自己的design system（支持shadcn/ui等）中可视化编辑，然后生成精确的代码diff交给AI Agent（支持MCP协议）。核心价值是将token消耗从测试中的25,700降至380（减少98.5%），同时保证改动精确性。完全本地运行，无需账号，目标用户是使用AI coding agents的设计师和开发者团队。产品刚上线PH仅61票，无公开用户数据或融资信息。

description_en: Smart Meeting Assistant for Mac that helps during the call . Parrot is a free, open-source meeting recorder for Mac that helps during the call, not after it. No bot joins: it records what your Mac hears and transcribes on device. When a client asks something your pricing sheet or FAQ covers, the answer appears with the file it came from. After the call you get a report of promises made and questions missed, and you can chat with all your meetings. Use Claude, a free local model with Ollama, or your own server. No account, no subscription.

title: Earnote

Record a lecture, meeting or your own explanation – Earnote transcribes it with Whisper and writes a structured note with tasks, flashcards and a PDF study sheet. Speech recognition runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac, and on iPhone 15 Pro and later even the note is written on-device. No account, no ads, no subscription. Free and open source (MIT); optional one-time Pro on iPhone/iPad.

full_profile.one_liner: mattpocock/skills — 开发者技能配置仓库，从个人.agents目录分享的Shell脚本集合，Matt Pocock是知名TypeScript教育者但此项目非商业产品
full_profile.overview_zh: 这是Matt Pocock个人的技能配置仓库，包含从他的.agents目录中提取的Shell脚本和配置文件。项目定位为'真正工程师的技能'，本质是开发者工具配置的分享。Matt Pocock是TypeScript社区知名教育者，但该项目更像是个人dotfiles的公开版本，而非独立产品。仓库包含24707个forks，显示出社区对其配置的兴趣，但这更多是教育/参考价值而非产品化的Agent框架。项目使用Shell语言，属于传统开发工具配置范畴，缺乏明确的AI Agent能力或产品化方向。
full_profile.biz_model_zh: 该项目无明确商业模式。作为开源配置仓库，不存在直接变现路径。Matt Pocock的主要收入来源可能是其TypeScript教育内容（课程、咨询），而此仓库更像是个人品牌建设的一部分。没有订阅、API付费或任何商业化迹象。与LangChain等开源框架不同，这不是平台型产品，无法通过企业版或托管服务变现。本质上是免费分享的个人工具配置，商业价值极低。
full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角：这不是投资标的。虽然Matt Pocock在TypeScript社区有影响力，但该项目缺乏Alpha信号：①非AI-native产品，仅是传统Shell配置 ②无产品化路径，不是框架或平台 ③无商业模式，纯开源分享 ④市场已有大量dotfiles/配置管理工具。唯一价值是教育参考，但这不构成投资机会。真正的Alpha在于能将开发者配置智能化、产品化的Agent框架（如Cursor SDK），而非配置文件本身。此项目更适合作为行业观察样本，了解开发者工作流，而非直接投资对象。风险是被误认为Agent产品而浪费评估资源。
full_profile.score_narrative_zh: AI Native得8分：虽然标题提到.agents目录，但实际是传统Shell脚本，无真正Agent能力，无模型调用、工具编排或自进化机制，仅是配置文件集合。Niche得6分：开发者配置是常见需求但同质化严重，dotfiles仓库遍地都是，无独特壁垒，Matt的个人影响力提供了一定差异化但不足以构成技术护城河。商业模式得3分：完全无变现计划，纯开源分享，无订阅、无API、无企业版，商业价值接近零。团队得9分：Matt Pocock是TypeScript领域知名教育者，技术能力强，但此项目非其主营业务。加分2分：开源且有社区关注（24707 forks）证明一定影响力。减分10分：严重信息不足-3分，非产品化项目-5分，无AI能力却用.agents命名有误导性-2分。

title: Jockey by TwelveLabs
description_en: Your entire video library: organized, searchable, understood. Jockey is the first AI that understands your entire media library across photos and video. It analyzes thousands of hours of footage so you can find and connect people, moments and context across videos. Use it in Claude or ChatGPT, or build with the API/SDK. Ingest YouTube, TikTok and Instagram Reels links; assemble content into MP4s; and create and share video-driven artifacts with playable clips. Every TwelveLabs model upgrade makes Jockey better, without re-integration.

title: SignWith
description_en: E-signatures without the subscription. Pay per doc.. Sign 3 documents free every month, then buy one-time credit packs from $9. Every account gets signing order, email OTP verification, audit trail and certificate of completion. Send from the app, the API, or AI assistants like Claude and ChatGPT using the MCP.

title: NitroStack
description_en: Build, test, and deploy MCP servers in one place. NitroStack is the full-stack platform for building production-ready MCP servers and AI apps. Build with open-source TypeScript & Python SDKs, test and debug visually in NitroStack Studio, orchestrate agent workflows with NitroStack Workflow, deploy on NitroStack Cloud, and ship branded experiences with NitroStack Chat. Auth, testing, deployment and frontend stay in one workflow. Connect to ChatGPT, Claude and other AI clients. Powering 80,000+ MCP servers.

title: Fish Audio Drama 3
description_en: AI voice acting you can direct, not just generate. Drama 3 is Fish Audio's latest AI voice model, built for performances you can direct. Turn scripts into expressive speech with natural-language control over emotion, pacing, whispers, laughter, and pauses — even within a single sentence. Create multi-character scenes, audiobooks, game dialogue, and narration across 83 languages. Available on the web, mobile, and API, with open weights for self-hosting under Fish Audio's community license.

title: Firefox Enterprise
description_en: Firefox for enterprises that want control of their data. Firefox Enterprise brings Mozilla's independent browser technology to organizations that want more control over their IT infrastructure and data. Built on the Gecko engine, it offers a self-hosted management console for centrally managing browser policies, access, data movement, and AI usage. It works alongside existing identity, security, and device management systems, helping enterprises reduce dependence on dominant browser ecosystems.

title: Lovable Growth Tools
description_en: From building your app to growing it, in one chat. Lovable can now help you grow your business. Set a goal like “my first 100 signups” and get a launch playbook built from your app. Launch ads to Google Search, YouTube, Maps, Facebook and Instagram. Get found in Google and AI search with Semrush data. Create images, video and copy from your builds. Unlike an agency or a pile of tools, it lives next to your app and traffic, and you approve before anything spends.

title: Notion: Context for your agents
description_en: Switch AI agents without re-explaining your work. Notion 3.8 turns your workspace into the shared context layer for every AI agent your team uses. Unlike chat tools that start from zero each time you switch models, Notion keeps your docs, databases, and Skills in one place any MCP agent can read and update. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP agent, plug Notion Agents into 150+ tools, sync Skills everywhere with the new Skills API, and see every agent edit in upgraded version history. Plus column permissions and rebuilt synced databases.

title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
description_en: NVIDIA’s open multimodal model for specialized agents. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is NVIDIA’s open, customizable multimodal model for specialized agents. It is a 120B mixture-of-experts model with 12B active parameters that handles text, image, document, and video input, plus reasoning and tool use, in one model. NVIDIA claims up to 5x higher agentic throughput on a single GPU than open models its size. Checkpoints, training recipes, and datasets are on Hugging Face, with a NIM container.

title: NANI???
description_en: Your interpreter and your boss doesn't even know.. NANI??? Ever sat through a call understanding nothing, then realised someone just asked you a question? Nani? learns who’s speaking by voice, right on your Mac, and floats live translated subtitles over any call. No bot joins, so nobody sees a thing. When your boss asks you something, it chimes and suggests replies you can say back, even in a language you don’t speak. Add context and a glossary before the call, and get a summary with action items after. Next time, you won’t have to say NANI???

title: FinderGit
description_en: Every Git repo on your Mac: browse, commit, review, clean. A native Mac file browser with Git built in: every repo's branch, status and changes in one window. New since launch, in 60 releases: • AI commit messages, built in or with your own key • Branches, stash, merge and rebase, no terminal • Dashboards for each repo and your whole workspace • Issues & PRs from GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Bitbucket • Repo Trust: see what a repo auto-runs before you open it • Cleaning: reclaim GBs of rebuildable dev junk. 100% native SwiftUI. No Electron. macOS 15+.

title: Maybloc
description_en: new SOTA for speech-to-text for multi-speaker audio. Speech-to-text built for conversations with more than one voice with highest accuracy than any in the industry. Lowest diarization error on several benchmarks. 45 languages, up to 25 speakers. Add-ons: subtitles, PII redaction, summaries, speaker names, translation. Better than Pyannote, Deepgram and Assembly AI

title: Grablo Spot
description_en: Free AI NVR that finds any person or vehicle in seconds. Grablo Spot is free AI NVR software for the cameras you already have. It records straight to your own machine and sorts every person and vehicle it sees into cards. Find anyone by face, appearance, plain text ("a person in a yellow shirt"), or a partial license plate, then follow them across every camera. Works with IP cameras, NVRs (RTSP/ONVIF), and USB webcams on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Raspberry Pi. Video is stored only on your device. No credit card, no camera limit, every feature free.

title: Leepik
description_en: Bank PDFs to Tally, with ledger mapping that learns. Turn bank-statement PDFs into Tally-ready accounting entries. Built for Indian accountants. Open beta: anyone can join, with all features free throughout beta. Leepik learns your ledger choices, reducing repeat work each month. Review balance checks and ledger suggestions, then export Tally XML or CSV. Statements are processed on Leepik's own servers, never sent to third-party AI or OCR services. Text-based PDFs only; scanned PDFs aren't supported.

Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
